name: Torr2Jelly
description: TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features direct TorrServer streaming, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Configurable Disk Cache: native TorrServer API integration for caching to fast disk/SSD (/mnt/sdb/AppFiles/jellyfin/cache/torrserver) with size presets (up to 100GB+) instead of small RAM cache.

Fix Jellyfin search engine releases filter: properly respect SearchOnlyGoldByDefault settings, sort by seeders when showing all releases, add interactive filter chips in search UI, and restore global tag checkboxes in settings.
Complete removal of internal/embedded TorrServer; dedicated external TorrServer architecture; permanent fix for library categories and folder paths persistence.

Settings fixes: fix settings saving error (declare missing variables and properly collect tracker rules and category mappings), fix responsive layout and CSS for categories and tag checkboxes, separate trackers list into dedicated full-width card.
Fix UI button scripts: resolve JavaScript SyntaxError caused by unescaped quotes in poster image onerror attribute in torr2jelly.html.

Filesystem and metadata language alignment: file and folder names on disk are strictly Latin/English (preserving original English titles or transliterating Ukrainian to Latin), while Jellyfin metadata (movie/show title, overview, tags) honors the library's PreferredMetadataLanguage (e.g. Ukrainian) by omitting title tags from NFOs when TMDb/IMDb IDs are available.

Fix Jellyfin metadata identification: map TMDb/IMDb IDs from Prowlarr/Torznab search, generate universal Kodi/Jellyfin NFOs (movie.nfo, tvshow.nfo) with standard uniqueid tags, intelligent dual-title and season noise cleaning in TitleCleaner, and display poster previews with TMDb/IMDb badges in search UI.

Fix movie collections generating TV season folders: movie collections in movie libraries preserve movie structure without seasons, support multi-movie collections with original filenames, per-tracker tag filters in Settings, and fix duplicate gold/silver tag bug.
Visual UI refinements: native gradient buttons, modern custom checkboxes, line clamping for release titles, and accurate status text for external TorrServer.
Jellyfin search integration: automatically suggests torrents from Prowlarr/Torr2Jelly when searching in Jellyfin, with 1-click addition to library.
Fix Jellyfin player error by replacing &preload with &play parameter in .strm files; default to external TorrServer (VPN) and allow disabling embedded daemon.
Fix getApiUrl/getAuthHeaders JavaScript scope error in Jellyfin SPA; clean modular global handlers for search, direct torrent additions, and library synchronization.
Fix search form submission in Jellyfin SPA: prevent native form reload, add direct window.t2jDoSearch handler on button and Enter key.
Inline onclick tab and action handlers with direct global state dispatch to guarantee button clicks work in Jellyfin SPA.
Fix Jellyfin querySelector('div[data-role=page]') stripping: moved style, fontawesome, and runner script inside the page div wrapper.
Fix Jellyfin SPA rendering: embed complete CSS styling and JS controllers directly in HTML without external link/controller dependencies.
Rich Glassmorphism UI redesign matching torr2jelly web app, Gold/Freeleech filters, direct TorrServer stream URLs, and automated defaults.
Initial standalone release with embedded TorrServer daemon and Prowlarr integration.
